Hayward, Wisconsin · stay

Hotels in Hayward for cyclists

Places to stay in Hayward when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the riding, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: Chequamegon MTB Festival.

Hotels in Hayward for cyclists, listed

  1. Flat Creek Hotel & Restaurant

    $$ · 10290 Highway 27 South, Hayward, WI 54843

    Full-service hotel with pool, whirlpool and its own restaurant and saloon; dogs welcome.

  2. AmericInn by Wyndham Hayward

    $$ · 15601 Highway 63 N, Hayward, WI 54843

    Chain hotel on U.S. 63 north of town with free breakfast, indoor pool and free parking.

  3. Holiday Inn Express & Suites Hayward

    $$ · Hayward, WI (listed by the Hayward Lakes visitor bureau, 715-634-0700)

    All-suite chain hotel with pool, whirlpool, sauna and fitness room.

  4. Northwoods Motel

    $ · Downtown Hayward, WI (visitor bureau listing, 715-634-8088)

    Family-owned motel in town; the budget pick near the Main Street start.

  5. Home Base at Mt. Telemark Village

    $$ · 42105 Telemark Road, Cable, WI 54821

    Ten rooms at the old Telemark site in Cable, next to the Chequamegon finish, with in-room bike storage, a wrench pavilion, bike wash and Park Tool stands.

  6. Lakewoods Resort & Golf

    $$ · Cable, WI, on Lake Namakagon (visitor bureau listing, 715-794-2561)

    Lake resort near the Cable finish with lodge rooms and condos; one of the festival's founding partners.
